patterns.note: Full-bleed hero video with centered overlay text and CTA, establishing a strong visual focal point.
Alternating dark and light background sections are used to visually segment major content blocks.
Grid-based layouts are consistently used for showcasing diverse content, such as partner logos, research cards, and news articles.
Large, bold sans-serif headings are used for section titles, providing clear hierarchy and impact.
A high-contrast black and white primary palette is used, with the dynamic hero video introducing varied and rich accent colors.
The full-bleed hero features a continuously playing video that dynamically changes its visual content, acting as a living background.
As the user scrolls, the main page content slides up and overlays the hero video, pushing the initial hero text and CTA out of view while the video continues to play behind.

technique_notes: A full-bleed video element is used as a dynamic background for the hero section, continuously playing and transitioning between different visual scenes to create an engaging first impression.

The main page content is designed to scroll up and over the hero section, creating a layered effect where the initial hero text and call-to-action are pushed off-screen as subsequent content reveals itself.
A sticky, transparent navigation bar is maintained at the top of the viewport, ensuring consistent access to site navigation without obscuring the hero content.

design_tokens.type_scale: Very large, bold sans-serif hero text (~4-5x body) with large, bold section headings (~2.5x body) and clear, legible body text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners on buttons and image cards, maintaining a clean and modern aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and a more compact grid for content cards.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its dynamic, full-bleed video hero that continuously plays and changes content, creating a highly engaging and almost interactive background for the initial scroll. This, combined with the clean, high-contrast design, gives it a sophisticated, Apple-like presentation for complex AI technology.
